title: Filming: Mull Of Kintyre by Wings | 1977
content:
In the afternoon of 2 December 1977 a second promotional film for ‘Mull Of Kintyre’ was shot at Abbey Road, directed by Paul McCartney.

The reason for the promo was because the radio edit of the song, which at 3:30 was more than a minute shorter than the full version, was judged to be more TV-friendly, but Michael Lindsay-Hogg’s first video could not easily be reworked to fit.

It featured Paul and Linda McCartney taking their pony Jet across the famous zebra crossing and into the studio, following by shots of Wings miming parts of ‘Mull Of Kintyre’ and playing instruments. A brief animated snippet from The Bruce McMouse Show was also included, of a cartoon mouse saying “Wings is here!”

The film was never shown, but a third promo clip was made on 9 December.
